scope: TWSE/TPEX domestic ordinary common equity technical price continuity
estimand: Can the selected raw or certified-transformed H/L/C price sequence be interpreted as one coherent technical price space for D03 indicators?

requiredPriceResetFamilies.meaning: Exchange ex-right/ex-dividend reference-price reset family, including rights/subscription resets when represented by the canonical exchange family.
Capital-reduction events that mechanically rebase exchange price/reference space.
Domestic ordinary-share par-value/share-unit conversion. Mechanical stock split/consolidation caused by official par-value change is mapped here and is not duplicated as a generic split family.

sessionContinuityFamily.requiredEvidence: Exact-window bounded source-honest suspension/resumption completeness with immutable source/digest/timing identity.

identityBoundaryFamily.bridgeRule: No cross-identity technical history inheritance unless a separately versioned same-security/economic-identity transform contract proves comparability and binds transformed history.

explicitNonRequirements: A separate generic SPLIT_REVERSE_SPLIT provider family is not required for domestic ordinary-common-equity mechanical unit changes already captured by PAR_VALUE_CHANGE.
ETF beneficiary-certificate split/reverse-split semantics are outside this ordinary-equity baseline.
Foreign/TDR/other security-class unit changes are not inherited into this family set.

Share-denominator-only events such as realized new-share listing do not automatically block raw price continuity when they do not reset exchange price space; denominator-based factors remain separately gated.
receiptRequirements: source evidence hashes for all required price-reset families
bounded suspension/resumption receipt identity and digest
failClosedRules: Three price-reset families clean does not certify continuity if security identity crosses a merger/share-conversion/delisting/migration boundary.
An open STOP interval without a positively certified RESUME/termination/active-through boundary may not delete expected sessions.
A legacy or status-only COMPLETE label cannot substitute for evidence-bound family coverage.
RAW bars across a certified price-basis reset may not be bridged without a certified transform.
RAW bars across an identity termination may not inherit recursive or finite-window state by default.
A price-reset-family pass cannot substitute for share-denominator vintage when a downstream factor consumes shares/market-cap.

bollinger.rule: All closes in the exact 20 eligible-session window must inhabit one certified price space and one continuing security identity. Identity termination starts a new Bollinger lineage by default.

adx.rule: Wilder H/L/C recursion may bridge a pure certified suspension in eligible-session chronology, but must use transformed replay across price-basis reset and terminates on security-identity termination unless a separate certified bridge exists.

d03W0AcceptanceExtension.addedConsumerRequirement: The W0 receipt must expose versioned PRICE_RESET_FAMILY_SET identity and explicit same-security identity-transition disposition; absence of an identity event must itself be supported by the bounded lifecycle/identity evidence contract rather than inferred from the three price-reset families.
d03W0AcceptanceExtension.firstWitnessScope: Domestic ordinary TWSE symbol only; TPEx parity and non-ordinary security classes remain independent.

maturityDecision.reason: This closes an ontology/consumer ambiguity and prevents underblocking. It does not provide the first real W0 receipt or genuine parent.

exactNextContinuationPoint: Consume the first real W0 receipt only if it binds D03_PRICE_RESET_FAMILY_SET_V0_1, exact-window suspension evidence, and explicit same-security identity-transition disposition to the selected replay. Independently consume a new ordinary-session genuine V8.20 Formal-to-C1 parent. Then run D03-10 Bollinger L3/parent-binding oracles; D03-09 additionally applies canonical Wilder full replay/trusted-state certification. Keep CORR-009 audit closure, raw third-session, T48, S2-07, dedup/redundancy and D16 incrementality separate.
